Privacy

Delete your data

For Options Explorer, US Stocks and TW Stocks by DappGo. None of these apps has an account, so there is nothing to close: deletion removes the records linked to the anonymous ID on your device.

What we keep on our servers

Only when you turn on push notifications does the app create an anonymous Firebase ID and store, under that ID, your push token (Apple APNs or Google FCM), platform, app, subscribed markets, language, time zone and notification settings. Options Explorer also keeps any feedback you send from the app. Older app versions may have left anonymous event records. We also keep a log of push delivery attempts (ID, market, result, time). None of these contain your name, email or Apple / Google account.

Options Explorer: delete in the app

  1. Open Options Explorer and go to Settings.
  2. Tap Delete my data and confirm with Delete.
  3. Restart the app when it asks you to.

This immediately deletes your users record (push token and notification settings), your feedback, and any legacy event records on our servers, signs out the anonymous ID so a new one is created next time, and clears the app's data on the device.

US Stocks and TW Stocks

These apps do not have the in-app button yet. Until they do:

  1. Turn off notifications for the app in your phone's settings (or with the signal-change switch in the app's notification settings). We stop sending immediately.
  2. Uninstall the app if you want the push token gone. The next time we try to send, Apple or Google reports the token as invalid and our server deletes it automatically. What remains is the anonymous ID and your notification settings, which can no longer be linked to your device.
  3. Questions or other requests: email admin@dappgo.com with the app name and platform. Because there are no accounts, we cannot look up your records by your email address.

What is kept

  • Push delivery logs (anonymous ID, market, result, time) are not removed by the button; they are kept for debugging as described in the privacy policy. Email us to have them removed.
  • Purchases and subscriptions stay with Apple or Google and with RevenueCat, linked only to an anonymous purchase ID, because the stores need them for restores, refunds and tax records. Manage or cancel them in your App Store or Google Play account.
  • Analytics and crash reports sent to Google Firebase are kept under Google's retention settings (up to 14 months for Analytics) and are not linked to the anonymous Firebase ID above. Turn off Optional detailed usage analytics in Settings to stop sending them.
  • Advertising data is handled by Google AdMob under its own policies; use the ad privacy choices in Settings and your device's ad settings.

Developer: DappGo (Yenlung Lai, sole proprietor), California, USA. Full details are in the privacy policy. Number RPG has its own account deletion page.
